nights.title: C.O.F.F.I.N
nights.name: C.O.F.F.I.N
nights.extract: Starting in 2005, C.O.F.F.I.N is a rock band from the Northern Beaches area of Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

nights.title: Bi-2
nights.name: Bi-2
nights.extract: Bi-2 is a Belarusian pop-rock band, formed in 1988 in Babruysk. During their career, Bi-2 achieved international success in Eastern Europe.

nights.title: Noah Gundersen
nights.name: Noah Gundersen
nights.extract: Noah Gundersen is an American indie folk singer-songwriter from Seattle.

nights.title: Dirty Honey
nights.name: Dirty Honey
nights.extract: Dirty Honey is an American rock band from Los Angeles, formed in 2017. It consists of singer Marc LaBelle, guitarist John Notto, bassist Justin Smolian, and drummer Jaydon Bean.

nights.title: Dea Matrona
nights.name: Dea Matrona
nights.extract: Dea Matrona are an Irish rock band based in Belfast and led by Orláith Forsythe and Mollie McGinn.

nights.title: Dead Poet Society
nights.name: Dead Poet Society
nights.extract: Dead Poet Society is an American rock band formed in Boston, Massachusetts in 2013.

nights.title: Marika Hackman
nights.name: Marika Hackman
nights.extract: Marika Louise Hackman is an English vocalist, multi-instrumentalist and songwriter.
